clean_body: The numbers tell a remarkable story. Let's keep showing up for our communities. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi Peter, It’s been a week since Election Day. We may not have gotten the outcome we wanted; there's no pretending otherwise. But before we turn the page, I think we should take a moment to recognize what we accomplished together. We moved the needle and there is a lot to celebrate. The narrowest Republican winning margin since 1992. Glenn Grothman won with just 52.75% of the vote with a 9.4 percent margin, the smallest margin in the 6th in more than three decades. A 13.2-point shift since 2024. We substantially narrowed the gap in a district that has been challenging territory for Democrats. 43.3% of the vote. We earned more than four out of every ten votes cast, putting our campaign's result on par with Dan Kohl's 2018 showing. $333,703 raised. That money came primarily from individual donors, almost entirely from within the 6th District. Thousands of people chose to invest in this campaign, and that is something worth recognizing. It also sets us apart from the campaigns who self-funded or raised large portions of money from out of state billionaires and corporate donors. An increase in our vote share percentage. Brad won Neenah by a 16.2% margin over Grothman, and Menasha by 17.1%, which helped elect Becky Nichols, and in turn helped flip the Assembly. Other communities shifted the margins too, some by even larger amounts: Bayside – 37.5% Appleton – 28.1% Portage – 24.8% Columbus – 24.3% Lodi – 23.4% Oshkosh – 21.9% Sheboygan – 18.6% Town of Caledonia – 13.5% Beaver Dam – 10.2% A campaign that reached all eleven counties. We built relationships, showed up in communities, had conversations, and demonstrated that Democratic organizing can gain ground throughout this district. Every one of those counties moved to a more Democratic vote. Volunteers are making waves. Hundreds of people stepped up to volunteer for our campaign. Many of them are now moving into leadership positions with the Democratic Party and building structure that will last long beyond this campaign. I ran because I believe the people of this district deserve a representative who puts them ahead of party politics and special interests. That message reached people well beyond our traditional base, and the results demonstrate that there is room for a different kind of politics in the 6th District. I am immensely proud of that and I hope you are too. To everyone who gave something of themselves to this effort, thank you for trusting me, trusting this team, and believing in what we were trying to accomplish. We may not have won this election, but we built something real. And our campaign was part of a much bigger story. Across Wisconsin, voters elected David Crowley as governor and every state-wide candidate. Democrats also won control of both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, and two congressional seats changed hands. Across the country, voters also delivered major changes in Congress, with Democrats winning control of both the House and Senate. There were historic firsts, new voices entering public service, and communities making their priorities heard. Whatever the outcome in any individual race, there was a tremendous amount of civic energy on display this year, and we should recognize it. Let’s keep showing up. We hope everyone who found a way to get involved in this campaign will stay involved in their communities. Attend your county board, city council, and school board meetings. Get to know the people serving in your local government, regardless of party. Call or email your elected officials when an issue concerns you. Ask questions, share your experiences, volunteer, and consider serving on a local board or commission yourself. Democracy needs more than participation every few years. It needs people who are willing to show up, pay attention, and make their voices heard throughout the year. Let’s get to work and keep fighting for Wisconsinites. Okay, this is a fun update, but I'm so excited I had to share.
A number of months ago, I was introduced to Neil Patrick Harris by a mutual friend. I've been a fan for years - from "How I Met Your Mother" to "Starship Troopers" to "Doogie Howser, M.D." to his Broadway exploits. I had coincidentally seen "Lost Boys" on Broadway, of which Neil is a producer, and loved it.
Sometimes, you meet someone and your fandom feels misplaced. With Neil, he's even more impressive in person. Neil came into the Noble Mobile offices and we bonded over having teenage children in the age of smartphones and social media. We resolved to try and find ways to work together.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e78b32fe-f92d-4807-838e-195835499a87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And so, yesterday, a new "Life" campaign featuring Neil launched. It's been seen hundreds of thousands of times in less than a day and is heading toward millions. You can check it out [here](https://substack.com/redirect/e301a4af-7a7e-44e9-aad4-225851308870?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And the second video is [here](https://substack.com/redirect/9685d0d2-f45e-438b-9ca7-7bf123fcfe5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - there's a whole fun series. Neil has joined me, Scott Galloway, Chelsea Handler, Arthur Brooks and others in trying to improve our relationships with our phones.
We launched Noble Mobile only 15 months ago. It's phenomenal to be able to work with some of the people I admire most to build an impactful enterprise. Sometimes, when you try and do something important to you, others join you and lend a hand. I've been privileged enough to have had that experience multiple times, and every time good things follow.
As most of you know, my vision goes a lot bigger, to switching us from scarcity to abundance. But that probably starts with putting our phones down and looking up and putting money back into people's pockets. Let's do our best to appreciate what we have while we have it. And that includes friends, both old and new.
Here's to "Life"! Let's make the most of it. Neil Patrick Harris just joined Noble!

It will save you money and time - hundreds of dollars for the average American. _Today, on Veterans Day, I have a new piece out in the Washington Examiner, co-written with Army veteran David Yeager, who courageously shares his personal struggle with gambling addiction and his journey to recovery._
_You can read an abridged version below and**[read our full op-ed in the Washington Examiner](https://substack.com/redirect/2681cb2e-7bc4-4a6d-8a84-1f0185881e2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**._
* * *
We are now a nation of **[gamblers](https://substack.com/redirect/c4154cbf-2530-435b-9faf-d3a42b18cc5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. Sports betting was once relegated to casinos and local bookmakers. Today, **[apps](https://substack.com/redirect/a527208e-ae55-4937-af49-54bd77a52af4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** have put a 24-hour sportsbook directly into the pockets of Americans.
This shift carries acute risks for service members and **[veterans](https://substack.com/redirect/9124cb1b-1e77-4852-9f95-e0e0aca804b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
A month after 9/11, one of us, David Yeager, deployed to a U.S. base in South Korea, leaving behind a wife and two young children. Looking to unwind from deployment stress, he walked into an on-base hotel, was met by a room of slot machines, and played a couple hundred dollars. He won.
That momentary rush planted a seed that spiraled over the next six years into severe addiction. David wiped out his savings, went through a divorce, lost contact with his children for two years, and survived four suicide attempts. While David is now in recovery, his story captures the central vulnerability across the ranks: A high-stress environment, steady pay, and an easy escape that quickly spirals out of control.
As the other of us, Patrick J. Murphy, saw while serving with the 82nd Airborne Division in **[Iraq](https://substack.com/redirect/debe03f7-6b70-4ad3-97fe-d4e467154506?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and later helping run the Army as Undersecretary, David's story is far from isolated. Troops have long gambled deployment pay in barracks card games or on overseas base slots.
But now it's even easier to access on mobile apps that never close.
[Read the full piece here.](https://substack.com/redirect/2681cb2e-7bc4-4a6d-8a84-1f0185881e2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

name: Johnny Olszewski
subject: Honoring those who served
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHNNY O FOR CONGRESS
body:
To all the brave men and women who answered the call to serve our country, thank you.

To every service member stationed far away from home, thank you.

To every military family persevering while loved ones are stationed on the other side of the world, thank you.

Today — and every day — we recognize the courage of the millions of American service members who sacrificed so much to keep our country safe and free.

But honoring our nation’s veterans doesn’t end with a few words of gratitude. That’s where it starts.

We owe these men and women real opportunities to thrive after their service.

We owe them support to transition back into civilian life.

We owe them a well-funded, well-resourced VA, so no veteran is left waiting for lifesaving care.

Just as these brave men and women have served us, I’ll fight every day in Congress to make sure our country serves them.

— Johnny Olszewski

clean_body: Two friends. Two razor-thin races. One chance to have their backs. | Two Senate seats are hanging by a thread, Peter, and they belong to two of my friends. Dan Sullivan of Alaska and Cindy Hyde-Smith of Mississippi are each in a race that is still too close to call, with Democrats holding razor-thin leads while the count continues. I've served alongside them, I know how hard they fight for their states, and I'm not going to stand by while Democrats try to win their seats. This fight could go on for a while, and it takes real resources to win it. Democrats are prepared to fight for these RED seats. We need to be able to match their efforts. If we lose these two seats, taking back the Senate next cycle becomes even tougher. I know we’ve been asking a lot all cycle, so if $8 is more than you can do today, Thank you for joining me in having their backs. God Bless, Tim Sheehy | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. subject: Happy Veterans Day!

body:
To every veteran reading this: Thank you.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=4120%2E21716%2Ekqa_kX)
Hi, Happy Veterans Day!
Today and every day, we honor the service and selflessness of our veterans, whose dedication to protecting our freedom is a debt we can never fully repay.
I’ve had the opportunity to meet with veterans who continue to serve their communities long after their military service — in our schools, hospitals, and local organizations across our state. Their unwavering commitment to community reminds us what service truly means.
I was proud that the first bill I passed as Delaware’s Congresswoman helped veterans and other underserved entrepreneurs trying to start a small business. In my second term, I’ll continue to champion the freedoms our veterans have fought to protect in Congress. I’ll keep pushing to ensure veterans have access to the care and services they need — and I’ll always fight for the benefits they’ve earned, including for Delaware’s VA hospital.
**_To every veteran reading this: Thank you._** Your service matters, and so does your future. I will continue to fight for you in Congress.
In solidarity,
Sarah McBride
Delaware’s Congresswoman

# [#]
Peter,

Today, we honor the courage, dedication, and immense sacrifices made by veterans here in Rhode Island and across our country.

Since our nation’s founding, millions of brave Americans have stood up for our country and put their lives on the line to defend our rights and liberties. We owe our veterans a debt of gratitude for their service, as they exemplify patriotism, heroism, and the true meaning of public service.

When it comes to supporting our veterans, words of appreciation are never enough; our actions must match our commitments. When our service members return home, our country has a fundamental obligation to deliver the care and opportunities they rightfully earned.

I am deeply honored to represent thousands of veterans and military families throughout Rhode Island’s 2nd District. You stepped up to protect us, and I will always have your back in Washington.

To all who have served: thank you for your service, your sacrifice, and your devotion to our nation.

— Seth

| Dear Peter,

Today is Veterans Day, and you'll hear President Trump and his administration claim to honor and support U.S. veterans.

The truth? [The Trump administration has left veterans and their families out in the cold.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/143288691/659710642/-807153797?sourceid=1151711&utm_campaign=27emeus-1101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=vaban&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMTBjYzQ4Mi1lYmRkLWYxMTEtOTFmNS0wMDIyNDgyNGQ5ZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gPWCc9yk1L8-plNb2FTPOmuECrJsfmR_n0OEAfa4x20=&emci=6b4fa57c-ebdd-f111-91f5-00224824d9f7&emdi=b10cc482-ebdd-f111-91f5-00224824d9f7&ceid=954237) It has banned abortion care through the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) health system, even in cases of rape, incest, or health emergencies.

Honoring veterans means protecting their health and their lives. [Add your name now to tell your representatives to end this cruel ban!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/143288692/659710643/-807153797?sourceid=1151711&utm_campaign=27emeus-1101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=vaban&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMTBjYzQ4Mi1lYmRkLWYxMTEtOTFmNS0wMDIyNDgyNGQ5ZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gPWCc9yk1L8-plNb2FTPOmuECrJsfmR_n0OEAfa4x20=&emci=6b4fa57c-ebdd-f111-91f5-00224824d9f7&emdi=b10cc482-ebdd-f111-91f5-00224824d9f7&ceid=954237) | [Add Your Name](https://click.everyaction.com/k/143288693/659710644/-807153797?sourceid=1151711&utm_campaign=27emeus-1101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=vaban&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMTBjYzQ4Mi1lYmRkLWYxMTEtOTFmNS0wMDIyNDgyNGQ5ZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gPWCc9yk1L8-plNb2FTPOmuECrJsfmR_n0OEAfa4x20=&emci=6b4fa57c-ebdd-f111-91f5-00224824d9f7&emdi=b10cc482-ebdd-f111-91f5-00224824d9f7&ceid=954237)

This is one of the most extreme abortion bans in the country. [It blocks care even in states where reproductive freedom is protected.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/143288694/659710645/-807153797?sourceid=1151711&utm_campaign=27emeus-1101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=vaban&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMTBjYzQ4Mi1lYmRkLWYxMTEtOTFmNS0wMDIyNDgyNGQ5ZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gPWCc9yk1L8-plNb2FTPOmuECrJsfmR_n0OEAfa4x20=&emci=6b4fa57c-ebdd-f111-91f5-00224824d9f7&emdi=b10cc482-ebdd-f111-91f5-00224824d9f7&ceid=954237) Here's what that means for the veterans who served our country:
* More than **400,000** women veterans live in states that ban or severely restrict abortion. For them, the VA was the last lifeline to care. Now it's gone.
* **One in three** women veterans reports experiencing sexual trauma during their service. Now they can be forced to carry pregnancies that result from rape.
* Veterans face a **higher risk of pregnancy complications** , and this ban can block the care that protects their health and saves their lives.

_The bottom line: Trump's ban puts veterans' health and lives at risk._

As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled.Duran had only moments to react.He didn't reach for his firearm.He didn't use deadly force. **Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him.** The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries.Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison.And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away.[**Will you help Sgt. clean_body: Convicted because of a cooler | | | | | | Dear Fellow American,This officer was just convicted of manslaughter for trying to stop a fleeing criminal with non-lethal force. Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD.He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. Now he's fighting for his own freedom – - All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx. | | | | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled.Duran had only moments to react.He didn't reach for his firearm.He didn't use deadly force. Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him. The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries.Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison.And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal.But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive.And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. They’re not only facing the reality of their husband and father spending the next 9 years in prison.Their own lives have been threatened because of this case. That's why I’m asking for your help today. spent 15 years protecting others. Now he needs people like you standing behind him. you for standing with Sgt. Duran. Sincerely, | | | Jason Johnson, President Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. I've been making the case to you all week that Republicans learned absolutely nothing from last week's drubbing in the midterms. So I wasn't the least bit surprised when they turned around and made Ohio Congressman Jim Jordan the House GOP minority leader.
This is them doubling down, again, on everything they've done over the last ten years to wreck this country and piss off the American people. It's no different than Donald Trump deciding that what the White House really needed after an electoral beatdown was Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff. These people are extremists. clean_body: Peter, We face powerful foes today who are willing to do anything to dominate America, even if it means destroying democracy. The Left's so-called principles are utterly incompatible with those that are the bedrock of our constitutional republic. They're incompatible with individual liberty and free will. They're incompatible with the Judeo-Christian belief system under which this nation was founded. At a time when the very values that make America great are under attack, we must continue to stand strong. We must make sure our fellow citizens understand the seriousness of this situation. I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. And I'll never stop calling out the leftiSUPERLIST who want to tear our country down. I know you won't either! I do a lot of things. But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation. Landmark Legal Foundation is on a mission. They 're here to protect liberty, property rights, constitutionalism . . . in other words, what you read in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. And now, I'd love you to stand with me in supporting this outstanding organization. The Left aren't saviors of democracy.They 're MarxiSUPERLIST. And what they're doing is destroying the country. They fight desperately to undermine our election processes and, if elections go against them, they use the courts to obstruct the policies We the People voted for. They persecute their opponents, like when the Biden In justice Department waged relentless lawfare against Trump and his allies. LeftiSUPERLIST focus so much energy on the justice system - to control it, to contort it, to use it to promote their insanely radical agenda. Again and again, they turn to rogue left-wing judges to usurp the Constitution and undermine America's founding principles. We must not be silent while these leftiSUPERLIST destroy our republic from within. That 's why it's so great to have Landmark Legal Foundation take them on! I love these guys. I've been part of the Landmark family for over three decades . . . as president for 20 years, then Chairman of the Board, and now Chairman Emeritus. These briefs present the strongest possible argument for the constitutional position and help convince judges to do the right thing. In 2024, Landmark made a historic winning argument that special prosecutor Jack Smith lacked the legal authority to target Donald Trump in the classified documents probe. The judge in the case echoed Landmark's arguments in her decision and delivered a huge win over the Left 's lawfare. Landmark also fights to defend free, fair elections. For example, Landmark filed a supportive brief in another key election integrity case. With Bost v. Illinois Board of Elections , they're helping challenge unfair vote-by-mail procedures. Here, Illinois Congressman Mike Bost sued the Illinois Board of Elections over their practice of counting mail-in ballots received after Election Day. Such counting delays results and opens the door for abuse. When the Supreme Court agreed, it marked a major victory for free, fair elections. But this is not the last fight! This isn't political . . . it 's about the Constitution! My Landmark friends are on the frontlines of the battle to preserve our country. They're a vital part of the conservative, constitutionalist force fighting for our country today. Your support will help Landmark Legal Foundation live up to its motto of " Defending Liberty, Fighting Tyranny." Thank you in advance for actively joining the fight! God Bless, Mark Levin Chairman Emeritus Landmark Legal Foundation Landmark Legal Foundation is a 501(c)(3) Not For Profit Organization. All donations are tax-deductible.

**Every year on Veterans Day, we pause to honor the courage, sacrifice, and quiet professionalism of the men and women who have worn our nation’s uniform.**

As a veteran, I’ve seen firsthand what it means to rely on the person standing next to you. In uniform, background and politics don't matter, only the mission and the team. That same sense of shared purpose and dedication is what our veterans bring to our neighborhoods, schools, and workplaces across California’s 19th Congressional District every single day.

Our service to our veterans cannot end when their active duty service does. The promise we make to those who put their lives on the line is a lifelong commitment.

To every veteran across Monterey and Santa Cruz Counties, from South San Jose to Northern San Luis Obispo County, and to the military families whose resilience carries our communities forward: thank you for your service, your sacrifice, and your continued leadership.

May we always honor your dedication not just with our words, but through our actions.

With gratitude and respect,

— Jimmy Panetta

Photo by Jim Watson/AFP via Getty Images.
A company acting on behalf of the Israeli government signed a contract last month with an American company that advertises its access to a database of more than 25 million "verified conservatives" to help Israel influence U.S. public opinion, according to newly disclosed federal documents.
Starboard LLC, headed by American media executive Ryan Coyne, signed an agreement with an Israeli influencer marketing firm acting "on behalf of the State of Israel," according to the documents, which were recently disclosed in line with the Foreign Agents Registration Act, or FARA.
The contract comes as the Israeli government contends with increasing hostility from sections of the Republican base over Israel's role in drawing the U.S. into a wildly unpopular war in Iran. Starboard is an important partner for any effort to influence conservatives in the U.S. The company acquired the right-wing social media site Parler in 2023, and quickly sold it later that year. But even after the sale of Parler, Starboard kept "data used for email and text message marketing," Coyne told WIRED in a March 2024 [interview](https://substack.com/redirect/60be6233-248b-4567-a35b-330525b56dcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Starboard also owns or promotes several conservative news websites, including American Wire and BizPac Review. Its most popular website is PolitiBrawl, a publisher of political content that attracts substantial audiences on media platforms like YouTube and Facebook. Its[ Substack account](https://substack.com/@politibrawl) lists more than 1.3 million subscribers.
The $500,000 contract, dated October 13 and filed with the Justice Department on October 28, outlines a 120-day campaign of public influence on behalf of Israel. The contract establishes a "persuasion pilot program that measures contact impact and sentiment analysis through regular polling," followed by "continuous content deployment, optimization, and measurement" to assess user sentiment. The contract requires Starboard to produce a final report that assesses the cost of changing a user's opinion, a metric referred to in the contract to as "Cost-Per-Converted-Voice."

Starboard continues to advertise its access to the data of conservative social-media users through its prior ownership of the platform and a broader network of conservative media platforms.
On its website, Starboard states that its acquisition of Parler gives the company and its clients access to the platform's politically engaged user base.
Starboard has previously performed fundraising work for President Donald Trump, and its website lists past work with Turning Point USA and conservative political figures like Matt Gaetz, Rep. Jim Jordan (R-Ohio), Rep. Elise Stefanik (R-N.Y.), and Vivek Ramaswamy. Starboard's website also advertises services in strategic communications and government relations, boasting that it "provides unparalleled expertise in navigating U.S. policy, regulations, and global opportunities, particularly now under the Trump administration."
## Parler Games
Parler was founded during Trump's first term as a self-styled free-speech alternative to mainstream social-media platforms, attracting a range of conservatives and far-right activists who accused platforms like Twitter and Facebook of censoring their views.
The platform became a focus of national controversy after the January 6, 2021, attack on the U.S. Capitol. Among the rioters that day were Parler users, some of whom were arrested. The social-media company's "unique business model and content moderation policies were likely a contributing factor in fomenting some of the violence" during the attack, according to [research](https://substack.com/redirect/002cdd32-0097-4277-bee6-3355977e6470?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) published by the public-policy think tank New America. Days later, Apple and Google removed Parler from their app stores, and Amazon suspended its web-hosting services over concerns about the platform's failure to moderate its content.
In April 2023, Starboard, previously known as Olympic Media, purchased Parler for an undisclosed sum. At the time, Coyne was [explicit](https://substack.com/redirect/613463da-0830-47b8-b98c-e85b4708da9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about the value of owning access to Parler's conservative user base, describing it as an opportunity to expand Starboard's advertising and publishing businesses. He said his company looked forward to "integrating that audience across all of our existing platforms."
Later that year, Starboard [sold](https://substack.com/redirect/a7790e8c-b125-463d-8ed8-001cc657293b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the platform to PDS Partners, whose owners included former Republican political operative Ryan Rhodes, who became Parler's CEO, and Elise Pierotti, a former Parler marketing executive who returned as its chief marketing officer. The identities of other investors were not publicly disclosed. PDS Partners is structured as a limited liability company. Rhodes and Pierotti have described themselves as its partial owners, while declining to identify remaining investors, leaving Parler's full ownership and financing structure unclear.
The Israeli government's hiring of Starboard comes amid a major spending campaign to shore up American support for Israel among conservatives who have increasingly [soured](https://substack.com/redirect/06a2dd3c-dc9b-4c87-bff2-4be7bc1ddf3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the U.S. relationship with the country--particularly younger generations angered by the war in Iran and U.S. support for Israel. Israel's 2026 budget [allocated](https://substack.com/redirect/9479b10d-ed18-42bf-839e-d2e63c0b32ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) roughly $730 million to its global public-relations budget, more than four times what it spent the previous year.
Israel has increased its interventions in U.S. public opinion over the last year, according to Eli Clifton, cofounder of the Quincy Institute for Responsible Statecraft. "This is in response to collapsing public support that extends all the way into conservative and evangelical communities that have long been seen as the electoral lynchpin for Israel's political support within the U.S.," Clifton, co-author of the book "Israel's Lobby," told Drop Site News.
"Retaining the support of conservatives and Republicans is vital if Israel will continue to maintain the status-quo levels of support it currently enjoys, despite the majority of Americans wanting greater distance between the U.S. government and Israel's genocide in Gaza," he added.
In a speech to evangelical Christian leaders in Florida in [December 2025](https://substack.com/redirect/57fda935-0cf5-479c-aff8-7cea8c1c8b97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu described the battle for public opinion in the United States as the "eighth front" in Israel's wars. Ordinary Americans, "especially on the conservative wing of the United States," must be a major focus of Israeli influence campaigns, he added.
Israel's public-relations spending spree has targeted both political conservatives and younger evangelicals across the country, using online platforms, right-wing media outlets, Christian influencers, and even location-based ad [campaigns](https://substack.com/redirect/68da0493-bfb3-4ffc-a239-b6df361c83e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) targeting places of worship. In July, an Israeli Foreign Ministry official [told](https://substack.com/redirect/1ea16023-96e9-4299-81c9-9ce5a7b70ecc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) TIME magazine that a central objective of the government's influence campaigns in the U.S. was to prevent conservatives from turning against Israel. The official added that the country was looking for partners "who understood the landscape of the internet and MAGA culture."
## "Cost-Per-Converted-Voice"
The contract was signed by Coyne, and lists an executive of the Israeli firm working on the state's behalf, Udi Mendelovits, chief financial officer of LDRS Group, or Leaders.
The FARA documents do not provide many details about the pilot program, but they indicate that Starboard is expected to identify target audiences and develop measurements of users' political views. The aims of the contract include "Audience Development and Panel Construction," "Content Production and Distribution," and "Optimization and Analytics," to be performed by Starboard over the course of the engagement.
According to the filing, Starboard is also required to measure how much it costs to change an individual's views--what the contract calls a "Cost-Per-Converted-Voice" assessment.
The contracting intermediary, [Leaders](https://substack.com/redirect/2d1971b5-4fae-4ecb-a12b-81138409d894?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), has previously organized social-media campaigns on behalf of the Israeli government. In February 2024, the company [contracted](https://substack.com/redirect/150bf70f-0d3b-48e7-8405-d5e4616e7d0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Davis Media NY to manage up to ten influencers producing pro-Israel content for social media. In December 2023, representatives of Leaders approached influencers in the U.S. and offered to pay them to promote content on Instagram, the Washington Post [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/1f580a21-c858-4d06-b924-4d8e9f9be9a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). FARA documents filed as recently as 2025 [identified](https://substack.com/redirect/150bf70f-0d3b-48e7-8405-d5e4616e7d0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs as the government agency represented through Leaders.
Although the formal agreement in the new filing names Leaders as Starboard's client, the[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/87cb03db-44aa-4824-b2bd-cdf9d3c34374?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)document footnotes repeatedly identify the agreement as "Starboard x Havas Frankfurt,"**** an apparent reference to Havas Media Germany, the Frankfurt-based subsidiary of the French advertising giant Havas.
Havas has served as a major intermediary for Israeli government-funded communications campaigns in the United States, working on behalf of Israel's Government Advertising Agency to hire American political consultants, advertising agencies, and public-relations firms. Among its [contractors](https://substack.com/redirect/f5603fb7-bed0-435a-9730-e9ec765ffa83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is [Clock Tower X](https://substack.com/redirect/ed2869b1-f842-49fc-81a6-4f45272f76bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a firm headed by Trump's former campaign manager Brad Parscale. In 2025, Clock Tower X agreed to a four-month contract with Havas for an initial $6 million.
That agreement called for the production of at least 100 original pieces of pro-Israel content for social media each month, with 80% targeting Gen Z audiences. The agreement also specified the integration of messaging into one of the country's largest conservative Christian media companies, Salem Media Network, in addition to efforts to shape how information about Israel appears in search engines and in LLM responses.
Starboard explicitly advertises its ability to promote clients' content through its YouTube audience and its online publications. Its marketing materials also advertise services for its clients including email marketing, text messaging, video advertising, and creative testing.
The contract signed with Leaders on behalf of the Israeli government does not specify what channels, if any, Starboard would use to promote pro-Israel messaging to conservative American social media users.

Parler Games Parler was founded during Trump's first term as a self-styled free-speech alternative to mainstream social-media platforms, attracting a range of conservatives and far-right activists who accused platforms like Twitter and Facebook of censoring their views. The platform became a focus of national controversy after the January 6, 2021, attack on the U.S. Capitol. Among the rioters that day were Parler users, some of whom were arrested. The social-media company's "unique business model and content moderation policies were likely a contributing factor in fomenting some of the violence" during the attack, according to published by the public-policy think tank New America. Days later, Apple and Google removed Parler from their app stores, and Amazon suspended its web-hosting services over concerns about the platform's failure to moderate its content. In April 2023, Starboard, previously known as Olympic Media, purchased Parler for an undisclosed sum. At the time, Coyne was about the value of owning access to Parler's conservative user base, describing it as an opportunity to expand Starboard's advertising and publishing businesses. He said his company looked forward to "integrating that audience across all of our existing platforms." Later that year, Starboard the platform to PDS Partners, whose owners included former Republican political operative Ryan Rhodes, who became Parler's CEO, and Elise Pierotti, a former Parler marketing executive who returned as its chief marketing officer. The identities of other investors were not publicly disclosed. PDS Partners is structured as a limited liability company. Rhodes and Pierotti have described themselves as its partial owners, while declining to identify remaining investors, leaving Parler's full ownership and financing structure unclear. The Israeli government's hiring of Starboard comes amid a major spending campaign to shore up American support for Israel among conservatives who have increasingly on the U.S. relationship with the country--particularly younger generations angered by the war in Iran and U.S. support for Israel. Israel's 2026 budget roughly $730 million to its global public-relations budget, more than four times what it spent the previous year. Israel has increased its interventions in U.S. public opinion over the last year, according to Eli Clifton, cofounder of the Quincy Institute for Responsible Statecraft. "This is in response to collapsing public support that extends all the way into conservative and evangelical communities that have long been seen as the electoral lynchpin for Israel's political support within the U.S.," Clifton, co-author of the book "Israel's Lobby," told Drop Site News. "Retaining the support of conservatives and Republicans is vital if Israel will continue to maintain the status-quo levels of support it currently enjoys, despite the majority of Americans wanting greater distance between the U.S. government and Israel's genocide in Gaza," he added. In a speech to evangelical Christian leaders in Florida in , Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu described the battle for public opinion in the United States as the "eighth front" in Israel's wars. Ordinary Americans, "especially on the conservative wing of the United States," must be a major focus of Israeli influence campaigns, he added. Israel's public-relations spending spree has targeted both political conservatives and younger evangelicals across the country, using online platforms, right-wing media outlets, Christian influencers, and even location-based ad targeting places of worship. In July, an Israeli Foreign Ministry official TIME magazine that a central objective of the government's influence campaigns in the U.S. was to prevent conservatives from turning against Israel. The official added that the country was looking for partners "who understood the landscape of the internet and MAGA culture." "Cost-Per-Converted-Voice" The contract was signed by Coyne, and lists an executive of the Israeli firm working on the state's behalf, Udi Mendelovits, chief financial officer of LDRS Group, or Leaders. The FARA documents do not provide many details about the pilot program, but they indicate that Starboard is expected to identify target audiences and develop measurements of users' political views. The aims of the contract include "Audience Development and Panel Construction," "Content Production and Distribution," and "Optimization and Analytics," to be performed by Starboard over the course of the engagement. According to the filing, Starboard is also required to measure how much it costs to change an individual's views--what the contract calls a "Cost-Per-Converted-Voice" assessment. The contracting intermediary, , has previously organized social-media campaigns on behalf of the Israeli government. In February 2024, the company Davis Media NY to manage up to ten influencers producing pro-Israel content for social media. In December 2023, representatives of Leaders approached influencers in the U.S. and offered to pay them to promote content on Instagram, the Washington Post . FARA documents filed as recently as 2025 Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs as the government agency represented through Leaders. Although the formal agreement in the new filing names Leaders as Starboard's client, the footnotes repeatedly identify the agreement as "Starboard x Havas Frankfurt,"** an apparent reference to Havas Media Germany, the Frankfurt-based subsidiary of the French advertising giant Havas. Havas has served as a major intermediary for Israeli government-funded communications campaigns in the United States, working on behalf of Israel's Government Advertising Agency to hire American political consultants, advertising agencies, and public-relations firms. Among its is , a firm headed by Trump's former campaign manager Brad Parscale. In 2025, Clock Tower X agreed to a four-month contract with Havas for an initial $6 million. That agreement called for the production of at least 100 original pieces of pro-Israel content for social media each month, with 80% targeting Gen Z audiences. The agreement also specified the integration of messaging into one of the country's largest conservative Christian media companies, Salem Media Network, in addition to efforts to shape how information about Israel appears in search engines and in LLM responses. Starboard explicitly advertises its ability to promote clients' content through its YouTube audience and its online publications. Its marketing materials also advertise services for its clients including email marketing, text messaging, video advertising, and creative testing. The contract signed with Leaders on behalf of the Israeli government does not specify what channels, if any, Starboard would use to promote pro-Israel messaging to conservative American social media users. clean_body: My message to you: | | | | Dear Patriot, The midterms weren’t what we expected. But that doesn’t change the job in front of us. It’s been exactly two years since I was sworn in. For the next two years I will keep doing exactly what I said I would do: protect the progress we’ve made, block the radical agenda the Democrats want to force through, and I will finish the job of Making America Great Again. I have total veto power, and I will use it when necessary. MAGA does not quit when the results are disappointing. We keep going. God bless you, and God bless the United States of America. Donald J. body:
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3095?t=1&akid=5821%2E35263%2E62uk0n)
**This Veterans Day, let’s honor those who answered the call.**
Today, we say thank you to the men and women who have served and sacrificed to protect the freedoms we hold dear. Their commitment to duty, honor, and service is the very best of who we are, and it inspires us every day.
That spirit of service is woven into the fabric of Wisconsin. It’s in our humble, hardworking values and in our deep American pride. And it lives on in the nearly 300,000 veterans who call our state home.
These neighbors, friends, and family members gave so much on our behalf. Now it’s our turn to show up for them. When they come home, they should have the care they need and the benefits they’ve earned, without having to fight for either.
To every veteran in Wisconsin: your service is an inspiration to all of us. You’ve done more for this country than anyone could have asked, and we are standing with you today and every day.
Each of us has a role to play. Whether it’s lending a hand to a veteran next door, supporting a military family, or simply saying “thank you,” we can make sure no veteran or military family faces their challenges alone.
Together, let’s keep our promise to our veterans, our wounded warriors, and their families, and serve those who have served us and this great nation we’re blessed to call home.
Thank you,
Tammy
